s -= 1
next_list = [-1] * n

    if s < m:
        s += t % n
    else:
        s += n - (t % n)
    s %= n
    t -= 1

cycles = t // n
prevs = s

while cycles > 0 and next_list[s] == -1:
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        if s < m:
            s += i
        else:
            s += n - i
        if s >= n:
            s -= n
    next_list[prevs] = s
    prevs = s
    cycles -= 1

if cycles > 0:
    cycle_length = 1
    prevs = s
    while next_list[prevs] != s:
        cycle_length += 1
        prevs = next_list[prevs]
    total = cycles % cycle_length
    for _ in range(total):
        s = next_list[s]

print(s + 1)
